name: Short Pour Drinking Glasses | Set of 4 | 250 ml each | Upcycled from wine bottles
shortStory: Elevate your everyday moments with O.U.A.T.’s handcrafted Short Pour Drinking Glasses, thoughtfully upcycled from reclaimed wine bottles collected across Goa. Designed for cocktails, juices, sparkling beverages and everyday sipping, these versatile glasses combine timeless design with conscious living. Each piece carries its own unique character, giving discarded glass a new purpose.

note.title: A Note on Uniqueness
note.content: Each glass is handcrafted from reclaimed wine bottles, so slight variations in shade, thickness, shape and finish are natural and add to its uniqueness. The shade of green or amber may vary depending on the availability of reclaimed bottles, making every set distinctive.

sections.title: Product Features
sections.content:
• Material: Upcycled wine bottle glass
• Set Includes: 4 handcrafted drinking glasses
• Capacity: 250 ml / 8.45 oz per glass | Height: 9 cm
• Colours: Amber and green, subject to bottle availability
• Ideal for cocktails, juices, sparkling beverages and other cold or room-temperature drinks
• Reusable: Designed for everyday use
• Net Weight: 1,300 g per set
• Dimensions: 40 × 12 × 12 cm (set dimensions)
• Shipping: Dispatched within 2–3 working days

sections.title: Care Instructions
sections.content:
• Handwash with mild dishwashing liquid to preserve the finish.
• Avoid harsh abrasives, steel scrubbers and strong chemicals.
• Suitable for cold and room-temperature beverages. Avoid hot beverages.
• Do not use if cracked or chipped.
